text: ArcaLogConsole is a product of the package beside ArcaMasthead. README says how an app makes a console, follows a file or a command, runs a command and adds a note. CHANGELOG lists it. design.md records the buffer's bounds: a console holds up to twice the capacity, its quiet lines and the rest each kept to it, so that a busy source's hidden request lines cannot push a command's output out. It also records that the classifier's marker and its tokens after an indent are ported from Intent, so a log line opening with `» ` takes the marker colour; the public surface kept, and why; and the file source's limits, with what WP-10's Gtools adoption does about them. Its release is 0.2.0, tagged on hv's word.
